title: TC-SPT-01-06 fails: applyRequestStorageRouting() falls back to LEGACY_RLS/public for an unprovisioned tenant ID instead of routing to the SCHEMA path
summary: Discovered while running the full integration suite (zig build test-integration) to verify the ISS-0098 fix. tests/integration/spt01_provisioning_test.zig's TC-SPT-01-06 ('pool checkout sets search_path to tenant schema for non-default tenant') fails: it sets tenant context to a fixed, never-provisioned test UUID (a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-e0f1a2b3c4d5) and expects search_path to resolve to that tenant's schema. Instead it resolves to 'public'. This test is unmodified by the ISS-0098 fix (identical since commit 9e37825, predates the ISS-0098 fix branch) -- confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to the ISS-0098 change.

root_cause.details: src/db/pool.zig's applyRequestStorageRouting() (lines 171-237) resolves storage_mode by querying 'SELECT storage_mode FROM public.tenant WHERE id = $1::uuid' for the given tenant_id (lines 184-191). When the query returns no row (as it does for TC-SPT-01-06's fixed, never-provisioned UUID) or the mode is not 'SCHEMA', the code defaults to LEGACY_RLS (line 206: 'Default: LEGACY_RLS (tenant not found, null mode, or any non-SCHEMA value)'), which routes to 'SET search_path TO public' (line 215), not the tenant's dedicated schema. TC-SPT-01-06 was written pre-ISS-501, when routing did not depend on a resolved storage_mode row existing in public.tenant -- it only depended on tenant_context being set to a non-empty UUID. The ISS-501 refactor added the storage_mode gate but this test was never updated to either (a) provision a real public.tenant row with storage_mode='SCHEMA' for its test UUID, or (b) assert against the LEGACY_RLS/public fallback that now correctly occurs for an unresolvable tenant. This is the same class of drift as ISS-0098 (test written against pre-ISS-501 SPT-01 semantics, never reconciled with the ISS-501 refactor) but affects a different test case and needs its own investigation into which correction is intended: either provision the fixture tenant with storage_mode=SCHEMA, or change the assertion to expect the LEGACY_RLS/public fallback for unresolvable tenants.

files_to_change: tests/integration/spt01_provisioning_test.zig -- TC-SPT-01-06: needs either a real public.tenant fixture row with storage_mode='SCHEMA' for the test UUID, or an updated assertion matching the documented LEGACY_RLS fallback for unresolvable tenants. Needs design decision analogous to ISS-0098's investigation before either side is changed.
resolution: Provisioned a real public.tenant row (storage_mode='SCHEMA') for a freshly generated UUID before acquiring the pool connection in TC-SPT-01-06, mirroring the pattern already used in iss107_tenant_storage_mode_test.zig and test_iss503_rls_removal.zig. This makes the test genuinely exercise applyRequestStorageRouting()'s SCHEMA branch instead of silently falling into the LEGACY_RLS fallback that TC-SPT-01-07 already covers. The inserted row is cleaned up via an unconditional defer regardless of test outcome. No production code changed -- pool.zig behavior is correct per the ISS-501 design. See src/design/fix-iss-0099.md. Verified via isolated zig build test-integration-svc run: TC-SPT-01-06 passes; the 74 other failures observed in the full suite are pre-existing, unrelated, and unchanged in composition before/after this fix (filed separately as ISS-0100 / GitHub #357).

occurrences.context: Surfaced during full zig build test-integration run while verifying the ISS-0098 fix (TC-SPT-01-07). Confirmed unrelated: TC-SPT-01-06 is byte-identical to its state before the ISS-0098 branch was created.

prevention: When a design doc (e.g. ISS-501) changes the preconditions a routing function depends on (here: requiring a resolvable public.tenant row for SCHEMA routing), audit existing tests that exercise that function with synthetic/unprovisioned fixture data -- they may silently start exercising a different code path (fallback) than the one they were written to test.

When inserting a public.tenant row from a test fixture, either set tenant_type='test' with a valid production_tenant_id (per ck_tenant_type_fk_coherence), or rely on an unconditional per-test defer cleanup rather than clean_test_db.py's tenant_type='test' filter -- the majority of existing tenant-inserting integration tests omit tenant_type entirely, defaulting to 'production' and leaking past clean_test_db.py's cleanup (tracked separately as ISS-0100 / GitHub #357).
